about.what: A second, independent reading of each paper excerpt by a different AI model. It saw only the paper text around the theorem and the hypothesis, never this project's classification. It is one AI checking another, not a verification.
about.question_which: For which L-functions is the hypothesis assumed in this theorem: only zeta and Dirichlet L-functions; also others; or not stated in the excerpt.
about.question_extra: Besides a Riemann Hypothesis, does the theorem also assume another unproved conjecture.
